title: Jalen Hurts expected to miss rest of season after bloot clot scare
summary: Jalen Hurts was placed on the Eagles' injured reserve list last week for a blood clot, but his agent announced Monday that it was more dangerous than initially thought. He is expected to miss the rest of the season after his diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in both of his lungs. Nate Burleson reports.
